title: Run several games at once
summary: Different games can start and run at the same time (issue #129). Core publishes one session per launch; the launch feature keeps a stop, an output buffer and after-launch behavior per session; Home shows the current game's own launch moment.

included: Core context publishes every session, keyed per launch
The launch feature keeps one slot per session: cancel, output, after-launch
Home keeps a launch moment per game and shows the current game's
The game page shows and stops its own game
excluded: Several processes of the same game (phase 2: shared launch lease, per-session marker, options.txt and latest.log conflicts, a second-process control)

tasks.title: Core: sessions as a list
tasks.acceptance: Context.sessions holds one entry per game; a launch of game B leaves game A's session; a failed session stays until that game starts again; core tests cover both

tasks.title: UI: one launch slot per game
tasks.acceptance: Launch keeps cancel and output per game; events name their game; stopping game A leaves B running; the launcher hides when a game runs and comes back only when the last one ends

tasks.title: UI: Home and pages per game
tasks.acceptance: Starting game B while A runs is allowed; Home shows the current game's moment; switching the current game shows that game's moment; a running game can not be started twice

tasks.title: Phase 2: several processes of one game
tasks.acceptance: Decided separately: lease, marker, options capture and log separation designed first

validation.criterion: Core and UI tests for concurrent sessions pass
validation.result: Passed: lumilio-core context (incl. two_games_publish_their_own_sessions), lumilio-ui launch + shell (incl. two_games_launch_side_by_side_and_end_on_their_own, home_keeps_each_games_launch_moment_while_another_is_current, the dependency table), lumilio-app live; clippy -D warnings clean.

validation.criterion: Real-window spot check: two games run, each stops on its own
validation.result: Passed in a real window (macOS, two vanilla 26.3 games, offline account): B started from Home and from the Library while A was launching or running; switching back to A showed its running moment; 结束游戏 stopped only A; Library 启动 on a running game showed 这个游戏已经在运行 and started nothing; ending B while A ran gave a toast and a 需要留意 row and left the launcher behind; ending A last brought it to the front with its recovery. With after_launch=hide the launcher hid on each game running, stayed hidden when the first ended and came back when the last ended. Windows not checked (community feedback).

decisions.decision: Different games first; the same game twice is phase 2
decisions.rationale: Core already keeps a lease per game. A second process of the same game shares its session marker, options.txt capture and logs/latest.log, which need their own design.
decisions.consequences: Starting a game that is already on its way or running is still refused, with its own message.

decisions.decision: Hide on the first running game, come back on the last ending one
decisions.rationale: Bringing the launcher to the front when one of two games quits covers the game still played.
decisions.consequences: after-launch is read per session; foreground-on-exit waits for no game to be active.

roadmap.name: Several games at once
roadmap.lede: Run different games at the same time
